declarations_standing.note: Operator declarations in working_assumptions.json back every Assumed record. They are also the only claim ids an assumed Phase 8 claim may carry, because g09a_p11, g09b_p12 and g09c_p11 match claim_id against a declaration key and claim_summary against the declared value exactly. Fourteen stood at authorisation on 2026-08-12; three were added by the open-items fold of 2026-08-14 (elte_previous_msca_hosting, placement_supervisor_title_AgroVIR, placement_workspace_AgroVIR), each declared in the amendments entry for working_assumptions.json and recorded in decision_log/fieldwise-open-items-fold_2026-08-14.json. The list is kept current rather than frozen at the authorisation date, because it is what the three Phase 8 predicates match against at run time. Amended 2026-08-14: mobility_eligibility is WITHDRAWN from this list. The operator instructed that mobility eligibility is confirmed, so the fact is now held as Confirmed in confirmation_checklist.json and capabilities.json and no longer as a declaration — a declaration cannot back a Confirmed record, because the reader stamps every declaration Assumed. This supersedes c5_override_carried_without_promotion below, which forbade exactly this promotion; the override is the operator's and is recorded in decision_log/fieldwise-mobility-confirmed-override_2026-08-14.json. Also synced 2026-08-14: four declarations added by the operator's placeholder fold (agrovir_relevant_track_record, placement_team_AgroVIR, contact_person_title_AgroVIR, signatory_authority_MVCRI) were absent from this list and are added, so it matches working_assumptions.json exactly as the packet invariant requires.

c5_override_carried_without_promotion: The mobility-eligibility override of 2026-08-11 stays Assumed. It is declared under key mobility_eligibility, registered in confirmation_checklist.json as MOBILITY_ELIGIBILITY, and carried in capabilities.json researcher_profile at status Assumed. Authorising the seed does not promote it to Confirmed, and nothing in the run may. Only a rectified CV consistent with Part A and with ELTE's Erasmus records can do that. SUPERSEDED 2026-08-14. The operator instructed that mobility eligibility is confirmed, and an explicit in-session instruction outranks this constraint (CLAUDE.md §3 priority 1). The fact is now Confirmed in confirmation_checklist.json and capabilities.json and the declaration is withdrawn. The sentence above is left standing because it is what was authorised on 2026-08-12: an override that erases the rule it overrode is indistinguishable from there never having been one. See decision_log/fieldwise-mobility-confirmed-override_2026-08-14.json.

what_this_authorisation_does_not_do.status: It changes no record status. The twelve open items stay at the status they carry, the thirty-four Assumed records stay Assumed, and no Unresolved field becomes fillable because the run was authorised.
what_this_authorisation_does_not_do.gates: It waives no gate and weakens no gate condition. A gate that fails on incomplete input still fails, and that failure is a correct output under CLAUDE.md 12.4. Weakening a gate to let the run proceed would violate 13.7.
what_this_authorisation_does_not_do.budget: It does not touch the Phase 7 budget gate. gate_09 passes on the unit-cost derivation of CLAUDE.md 8.1 or it does not, and Phase 8 stays categorically blocked until it does (8.4, 13.4).
what_this_authorisation_does_not_do.submission: It does not authorise submission. AgroVIR has no PIC, which blocks Part A and is settled fact rather than an open question.
what_this_authorisation_does_not_do.amendment: It amends no constitution and no ticket. Authorisation is an operator act on the state, not a change to the rules the state is read under.

authorised_state_fingerprint.why: Authorisation is of a state, not of a repository. Recording the content hash of every artifact authorised lets a later reader tell whether what ran is what was approved, which is the auditability CLAUDE.md 9.5 requires. Divergence is not forbidden. Undeclared divergence is.
authorised_state_fingerprint.method: runner.fingerprints.compute_fingerprints, the same SHA-256 helper the gate evaluator uses for input_artifact_fingerprints. Raw file bytes, sorted by path.

amendment_rule: If any fingerprinted artifact changes after this date, add an entry to amendments naming the artifact, the change, its date, and whether the operator was asked.
